notes.title: The Twisted & The Hollow Is Now Available!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of ZEPHON's first DLC: The Twisted & The Hollow!

This DLC includes 2 new leaders, 7 new units, 3 new operations, 3 new items, 2 new outposts, 5 new quests, 4 new mutators and 4 new tracks.

Accompanying the DLC we're also releasing an extensive patch that adds 4 new technologies, new illustrations, ambient sounds and a plethora of gameplay, quality of life and balance improvements.

A few gameplay changes we'd like to highlight:
[list]
[*]Each leader now has a different set of starting units. If a unit is exclusive to a DLC and that DLC is disabled, the unit will be replaced by a cost-equivalent amount of default branch units (Militants, Abkluth Dragoons, Ishim Enforcers).
[*]Enemy units on city tiles now disable all buildings on the tile.
[*]Increased variety of neutral units: Human, Voice and Cyber units up to tier 2 now also spawn as neutrals.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607430/ZEPHON__The_Twisted__The_Hollow/

Enjoy!

# Version 1.1.0

## New
* Added The Twisted & The Hollow DLC content.
* Added new researchable technology Shield Dome (tier 6, non-affinity): +17% city damage reduction for headquarters.
* Added new researchable technology Mobile Hardpoints (tier 7, Human): +8% ranged cover damage reduction for non-flying Human units if they have not moved.
* Added new researchable technology Railgun Roads (tier 8, non-affinity): Doubles road movement bonus.
* Added new researchable technology Market Defluctuation (tier 9, non-affinity): -50% Concordat buy prices.
* Added unique illustrations and ambient audio for the leader quests.
* Each leader now has a different set of starting units. If a unit is exclusive to a DLC and that DLC is disabled, the unit will be replaced by a cost-equivalent amount of default branch units (Militants, Abkluth Dragoons, Ishim Enforcers).
* Enemy units on city tiles now disable all buildings on the tile.
* Enemy units on outposts now disable all gains from that outpost.
* Increased variety of neutral units: Human, Voice and Cyber units up to tier 2 now also spawn as neutrals.
* Caches can now give operation rewards.
* Added a use-item animation for each hero.
* Allies and spectators can now see which technologies have been researched and are being researched by others in the research screen.
* Spectators can now access the communications screen to see the standing and treaties of all players.
* Added ability to easily select units with queued orders before executing their orders. The end turn button now becomes "Order Queued Units (X)" / "Execute Queued Order (1/X)" to select and execute orders one by one. Right-clicking the end turn button when it's in this state executes all queued orders.
* Added "Victory Requires Defeating NPCs" advanced setting (defaults to on).
* Number keys now scroll to the corresponding tier in the research screen.
* Added "Enemy In City", "Combat" and "Combat (Advanced)" tips.
* Added loading tips about mass-moving units and sight blocking features.
* Added more ambient audio to terrain features.

## General
* Non-affinity branches are now hidden by default in the research screen.
* Improved unit voice line playback so it is less likely that they repeat. The likelihood of a line repeating depends on how long ago it was last played, and any lines played within a minute will not play again.
* Improved performance of the research screen.
* Default control bindings now better take into account non-QWERTY layouts by preserving the key letter (CTRL+Y for yield overlay) or preserving the key position (QWE for unit actions) where appropriate.
* Player abilities now trigger notifications (e.g. Words of the Prophet converting one of your units).
* Notifications of abilities that target enemies are now colored red.
* Notifications that affect custom-named units now show the custom name instead of the generic unit name.
* Attack area now only considers line of sight rather than attackability, so it also shows over allied units. This makes it clearer to see a unit's general attack range.
* Atramentous Aura can now target any tile.
* Renamed Combat Drone, EMP Drone and Repair Drone to Combat Melisai, EMP Melisai and Repair Melisai.
* Increased Vulkan R-5 size by 10% to closer match Plangent Orolos.
* Overcharged +1 armor penetration is now in the trait instead of the weapons for increased clarity.
* The Deep can now only be accessed once per game.
* New (not previously picked) The Deep options are now clearly marked.
* Nightmare, Acrin Bone Whistle and Tribunal Tether summons now appear more synchronized with casting animation instead of instantly.
* Resources granted every X turns (Acrin Crash Site, Hwedo's Brain, Neumanatic Cornucopia) now in the total resources display when they would trigger next turn.
* Features that block sight, now explicitly say it in their associated entries.
* Show button to open research screen from the start.

**AI**
* AI now treats Combat Medics as support units regarding usage and positioning.
* AI now produces less Combat Medics relative to other unit types.
* AI Untold Prophet will no longer use Word of the Prophet on summons.
* AI units under System Overload no longer attack with low hitpoints.
* Improved AI unit targeting, especially for units with Cone and Area weapons.

## Balance
* Higher difficulties now have increased AI diplomatic aggressiveness.
* Hovering units now benefit from Roads.
* Increased Life Steal trait life steal from 10% to 20%.
* Increased Incendiary Grenade damage from 1 to 1.5.
* Rebalanced cache reward chances to be 4 : 2 : 1 : 1 for resource:item:operation:unit.
* Spirit of Mankind is now a tier 10 research and permanently increases loyalty by 10.
* Asymmetric Arbitrage is now a non-affinity technology.

**Human**
* Smoke Screen is now a free action.
* Interceptor Missile is now a free action.
* Reduced Shiraki Cruise Missile range from 12 to 9.
* Increased Argosy Targe invulnerable damage reduction from 50% to 67%.
* Reduced Antimatter Diffraction invulnerable damage reduction bypass from 33% to 17%.
* Increased Gauss Cannon damage from 8 to 12.
* Increased Gauss Cannon armor penetration from 6 to 7.
* Increased Power Fist damage from 12 to 16.
* Increased Power Fist armor penetration from 7 to 8.

**Voice**
* Precentor of Nihilus now increases the experience of all produced units by 2 for each Midnight Chorus in the city instead of the previous effect.
* Reduced Dark Vassael cost and upkeep by 25%.
* Reduced Fallen Orolos cost and upkeep by 25%.
* Reduced Surthodai's Embrace cost and upkeep by 33%.
* Reduced Plangent Orolos cost and upkeep by 33%.
* Nightmare dying no longer affects experience.
* Apotheosis dying unit no longer affects morale or experience.
* Increased Apotheosis damage from 4 to 6 and armor penetration from 3 to 4.
* Aegyllan Worm Tunneling now applies Stealth for 1 turn.
* Increased Aegyllan Worm cost by 33%.
* Pestilence is now a free action with cooldown 3.
* Increased Deathshriek damage and armor penetration from 2 to 3.
* Increased Essence Syphon from +1 to +2 armor.
* Surthodai's Kiss now only affects Voice units, and heals 1 hitpoint in Bleed (instead of 2 from Bleedwalker).
* Halved Choral Celerity cost.
* Vorodai Proselyte now has Indirect Fire.
* Withering Breath now has Corrosive.
* Shrieker now has Concussive.
* Increased Hymn of Decay morale loss on use from -1 to -2.
* Increased Dimensional Reverberations from +1 to +2 dimensional echoes per kill.
* Increased Pestilence attacks from 1 to 2.

**Cyber**
* Holopatter now affects all Cyber units instead of all non-large, non-flying units.
* Marked Target now also works for melee weapons.
* Antiparticle Purge now also removes Abkhan Drey and Sandpit.
* Fixed Singularity Blade having 6 range instead of 3.
* Increased Interpolated Production minerals cost reduction from -5% to -10%.
* Interference Protocols can no longer target titan units.

**Emulated Mind**
* Increased Mind Hack duration from 5 to 10.

**Furtive Tribunal**
* Scimystic Scismatics now gives influence instead of research.

**Heartless Artificer**
* Part Distribution now affects Antigrav Assembler instead of Synthetic Printer.
* Increased Transuranic Apathy production cost for Seraphim Archangel from -6 (-8.3%) to -25%.
* Default Immoral rank now shows as 0 and gives -0 loyalty.

**Practical Romantic**
* Hardening Hearts now gives +8% invulnerable damage reduction for a turn when the unit loses morale due to unit death instead of -10% morale loss.
* Memories E'er More now prevents units from being shaken instead of -10% morale loss.

**Rogue Operative**
* Increased Icarus Satellite attacks from 1 to 2.
* Decreased Icarus Satellite damage from 12 to 8.
* Decreased Icarus Satellite armor penetration from 7 to 6.

## Bug Fixes
* Fixed a potential crash when the only tile candidates for quests were too far away.
* Fixed a crash in Korean translation when selecting Destroy Shards in Under Observation.
* Fixed a crash that could occur when selecting hotseat save games.
* Fixed Antimatter Diffraction doing more damage than intended to targets without invulnerable damage reduction.
* Fixed taking passive damage canceling unit orders (e.g. Decaying cancelling a long movement order).
* Fixed adding multiple non-stacking items affecting heroes multiple times (e.g. Iok'la healing).
* Fixed Seed of Extinction affecting non-enemies.
* Fixed Atramentous Aura and Experimental Drugs (Success) not increasing movement.
* Fixed AI being able to build heroes above the hero limit.
* Fixed Abkhan respawning as non-neutral under some circumstances.
* Fixed units under Dream Prison by the Anchorite standing still.
* Fixed Hast not being usable saying "No actions remaining." instead of "No movement remaining.".
* Fixed control bindings showing the incorrect key on non-QWERTY layouts.
* Fixed ESC not closing lobby screen while in a game.
* Fixed Concordat screen fading to black when closing.
* Fixed spectators being asked to select research.
* Fixed Phoenix Interceptor death effects.
* Fixed Zephon Black Site portrait.
* Fixed Gauss Rifle icon.
* Fixed Life Steal trait icon being low resolution.
* Fixed Acrin Zealots unit name not being plural.
* Fixed Cr'la Disciples unit name not being plural.
* Fixed Titan Melee trait not mentioning that it can hit flying units and attack over cliffs.
* Fixed Schism of Regimina not mentioning that it cannot target headquarters.
* Fixed Pulling trait not mentioning that it cannot target titans or fortifications.
* Fixed Commander Take Cover and Never Surrender targeting text.
* Fixed Dark Caress not mentioning that it also affects the unit it is on.
* Fixed Dream Prison usage notification not showing.
* Fixed Can Love Be Moral? mutator.
* Fixed offering peace to Anchorite not showing unique per-leader text.
* Fixed some debug panel crashes.
* Fixed some typos.

notes.title: Post-Release Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're thrilled with how the release has gone and are overwhelmed by the positive feedback—a huge thank you to everyone who bought and is playing ZEPHON! It's extremely motivating to see after working on the project for this many years.

While during the first week we mainly focused on chasing down bugs and taking in feedback, rest assured that plans to further expand and enrich the universe of ZEPHON have already been set in motion.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: ZEPHON Demo 9 (July 18th to July 29th)
notes.content:
The last ninth playable demo of ZEPHON will be available from July 18th (@ 12 pm CEST) to July 29th (@ 12 pm CEST) on Steam.

There are no big changes in this demo—it's meant for one final round of testing and feedback before release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1481170/ZEPHON/

[i]This is an early look at an in-development alpha version of the game. As such, there will be bugs, imbalances and missing assets.

The demo includes single player and multiplayer, but is limited to up to four players on a medium-sized map. 5 different leaders are available for selection and 3 NPC factions are present. Research progress is limited to the first 6 tech tiers.

The full version will contain larger maps, advanced game setup options, 8 leaders, over 50 units spread across 10 tiers of research, more terrain features and quests, an end-game grand finale, unlockable game modifiers, achievements, multiple languages as well as full workshop support.[/i]

[h3]Changes in Demo 9[/h3]
## New
* Whispering Wights that reduce unit morale each turn now randomly spawn on wasteland tiles.
* AI players now praise wars with common enemies.
* New Hashamllim Host voice over.
* Actions that create units (e.g. Create Shoch'itris Lair) can now be right-clicked to open the compendium for the unit entry.

notes.content:
The eight playable demo of ZEPHON will be available until June 27th (@ 12 pm CEST) on Steam.

The biggest change in this demo is the addition of tier 6 research, voiced leader reactions and diplomacy improvements. See the full changes below.

Come join us in celebration and let us know what you think of ZEPHON.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1481170/ZEPHON/

[i]This is an early look at an in-development alpha version of the game. As such, there will be bugs, imbalances and missing assets.

The demo includes single player and multiplayer, but is limited to up to four players on a medium-sized map. 5 different leaders are available for selection and 3 NPC factions are present. Research progress is limited to the first 6 tech tiers.

The full version will contain larger maps, advanced game setup options, 8 leaders, over 50 units spread across 10 tiers of research, more terrain features and quests, an end-game grand finale, unlockable game modifiers, achievements, multiple languages as well as full workshop support.[/i]

[h3]Changes in Demo 8[/h3]
## New
* Added tier 6 technologies (NOTE: Voice tier 6 units will hopefully be playable later in the event).
* Added voiced leader reactions to enhance immersion.
* Added Chayot Exterminator voice over.
* Added first story interlude.
* A lot of diplomacy actions now show the major impact on the decision.
* AI players will now condemn you for participating in the destruction of a city of theirs that isn't the last one.
* When unsuccessfully convincing an AI leader of terminating a peace treaty, trade agreement or alliance with a third party, they might report the attempt to the third party, which will then condemn the interference attempt.
* Research completed screen now has a button for select research.
* Show trait rank next to the small trait icons.
* Previous behaviour and extortionate nature will now be listed as major decision impact when appropriate.
* Added story interlude ambient audio.
* Hovering the mouse over a damaging trait icon like Bleed or Sandstorm now shows damage result for the selected unit.

## General
* Weapon icons of low power weapons, and heavy weapons on units that have moved, are now colored red.
* Non-native factions can now be asked for third party actions on native factions.
* How likely an AI is to offer gifts is now affected by their difficulty setting.
* Halved the standing change for praising and condemning traits.
* An AI's generosity characteristic no longer has an impact on them demanding tribute.
* AI now prefers other targets over those under the effect of Dream Prison.
* Renamed the Missile Team's Missile Launcher to Missile Bot.
* Unit response sounds now get less quiet with the camera's distance to the unit.
* Improved turn times.
* Traits are now only colored as Buffs and Debuffs if they are temporary.
* Made land generation more varied and natural.
* AI admit defeat dialogue is now sent to everyone, not just to enemies.
* When successfully convincing a player of terminating a peace treaty, trade agreement or alliance with a third party, your standing with that third party will now decrease.
* Removed that when the AI rejected a map exchange, trade agreement or alliance, it would result in a guaranteed rejection when asked again in the near future.
* Player abilities can now be used in quick succession.
* Abilities that spawn units now also say the description of the unit.
* Improved AI evaluation on when to gift.
* The Informant quest no longer considers a human player for the betrayal.
* Traits and weapons that come from upgrades are now colored blue.
* Concordat sell and buy button backgrounds are now more visible.
* Updated Anchorite voice over.
* Updated icons: Fallen Orolos, Kriteria Annihilator, Bio-Acid Spray, Poisoned.
* Adjusted colors to be more distinct.

* Splash and Large Splash now hit additional group members with half accuracy.
* Increased Fragmentation Grenade damage from 1 to 1.5.
* Decreased Anti-Armor Grenade damage from 3 to 2.
* Increased Anti-Armor Grenade armor penetration from 2 to 3.

* Reduced Erelim Assassin armor from 6 to 4.
* Increased Commander armor from 4 to 6.
* Increased Whisperer of Goldrauch accuracy from 6 to 8.
* Increased Horrors of Space damage from 1.5 to 2.
* Increased Horrors of Space armor penetration from 2 to 3.
* Reduced Disintegrate damage from 16 to 12.
* Reduced Disintegrate armor penetration from 8 to 7.

* Added Ignores Cover to Hymn of Decay.
* Increased Bio-Acid Spray armor penetration from 2 to 3.

* Units On Fire now lose 2 hitpoints per turn instead of taking On Fire weapon damage.
* Changed Shoch'itris Lair cost for Dark Vassael from 30 food and 15 algae to 20 algae.
* Reduced Baneful Omen attacks from 2 to 1.
* Reduced Cr'la's Gambit attacks from 2 to 1.
* Rebalanced advanced resource values and their production buildings.
* Increased Tachyon Ray damage from 2 to 4.
* Increased Tachyon Ray armor penetration from 3 to 5.
* Decreased Tachyon Ray attacks from 2 to 1.

* Increased Surthodai's Embrace armor from 2 to 4.
* Increased Fallen Orolos armor from 2 to 4.

* Decreased Pestilence cooldown from 3 to 1.
* Increased Orolos Cannon armor penetration from 6 to 7.
* Increased Surthodai's Hand armor penetration from 5 to 6.
* Decreased Tune duration from 3 to 1.

* Fixed "Leashed" text appearing when capturing an unleashed unit.
* Fixed Chieftess never founding new cities.
* Fixed Assassinate above level 1 not applying Crippling properly.
* Fixed some building trait upgrades not showing in the hint.
* Fixed Evasive Maneuvers not having a duration of 1.
* Fixed quest screen sometimes getting stuck.
* Fixed wrong production turn duration in hints of not queued actions.
* Fixed NPC advancements not increasing production cost.
* Fixed thrown grenades not being visible and not rotating with flight curve.
* Fixed units forgetting their rally target when moving out after being produced.
* Fixed Shoch'itris Lair, Bunker and Tessera Core not playing appear sounds.
* Fixed hitpoints sometimes being incorrect when a unit is taken over.
* Fixed Bleed Cultivation allowing construction of defensive structures on Bleed even outside of cities.

* Fixed Smoke Screen from Vanquisher lasting forever.
* Fixed an issue with units sometimes starting a wrong path when coming out of production.
* Fixed issues with planting Bleed with Construction Yard.

* Deep and shallow water color are now specified in Environment.xml. Note: The environment parameters can be reloaded while the game is running by pressing Ctrl+R.

notes.content:
The fifth playable demo of ZEPHON will be available from February 12th (@ 12 pm CEST) to February 19th (@ 12 pm CEST) on Steam.

* Added new technologies to tiers 1 through 3.
* Added multiplayer mode.
* Added The Dream and The Sky, Fallen quests.
* Added new unbranched research complete illustration.

* Rewritten many diplomacy dialogue lines.
* AI now buys and sells resources.
* Improved AI item usage.

* Flying units now affect and are affected only by other flying units' zone of control.

* Fixed being able to communicate with defeated players.
* Fixed not getting rewards from killing Abkhan when using Erelim Assassin's Assassinate ability.

notes.title: ZEPHON Research Reveal
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/Kkm5DNesye][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40653182/9b719d49d0d3c75738481be059f8cbf6c7965917.png[/img]
[i]Join our Discord to follow each segment of a reveal as it happens every Monday.[/i][/url]


[h3]Research[/h3]
ZEPHON’s research continues the tradition of a tiered progression system. It will feature over 150 technologies across 10 tiers. To advance from one tier to the next, 3 technologies are required. 

That may sound like a lot compared to Gladius, but we’re reducing research costs by 33% to compensate. Instead of a baseline of 6 turns to unlock a new technology, it will now only take 4 turns.

If that’s not to your taste for any reason, research cost and unlocks per tier will be customizable per game as a world setting.

[i]Players begin by attempting to recover from a primitive and scrappy level of technology in the first third of the game (post-apocalyptic, think Mad Max), followed by a more advanced second third (Blade Runner or Ghost in the Shell paired with magic), to a highly advanced last third (Alastair Reynolds’ Revelation Space universe or Dan Simmons’ Hyperion).[/i]

Each leader will also have 5 special technologies to enhance their unique properties—spread evenly through the research tiers.

We are pushing the boundaries of modifiers to new degrees. It’s very exciting to see conditional building bonuses in action—scaling building output depending on terrain features or even synergizing with other buildings to create combat effects in a radius.

To make all of this clear, we’re adding an often-requested Gladius feature: showing exact modifier numbers in technology hints. No need to search through the compendium for the information anymore.

[h3]Specimen Containment[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40653182/6da36753edc88e714eec3d319b8cd2cc7a4ce88f.jpg[/img]

[i]Many of our early learnings were rediscovering what went before. In time, though, we realised how much the familiar had shifted—how far man had killed off Earth’s species before the Acrin even arrived and how much new life the aliens had brought with them across the stars, life that filled out the world’s emptied niches. Capturing and studying that new life proved to be inspirational for our eventual victory…[/i]

Tier 1 : Human : Player Upgrade

Gain research from killing unaligned neutral units.

[h3]In Death, Life[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40653182/2d93bff0ba833378987f7db650cbdb49942bdadf.jpg[/img]

[i]An old flame once told me how the Aztecs or the Mayans—one of those dead empires—how their gods drew power from bloody sacrifice in their city centers. I didn’t understand what she meant until I saw troops mown down on the doorstep of a Voice-corrupted city and heard the unearthly ullulation from within. Whether it was true magic or just motivation, that city grew strong on death.[/i]

Tier 3 : Voice : Building Upgrade

Regain production from biological units that die in 6 tile radius from the headquarters in each Canticle of Dusk in the city.

[h3]The Mind's Eye[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40653182/851bb35defc92c1b6caae57f606f39d49229f9aa.jpg[/img]

[i]When I was a young fool, gossip went around; of a scientist, a genius, who died attempting to fulfil that old billionaire dream of living forever by uploading herself. It didn’t work, of course-the giant machine was inert, unmotivated, left operating as a curiosity. Until ZEPHON found it and brought that mind to life, focussing its will as a weapon against the invading Acrin. In time, its—I should say, ‘her’—her will could stretch for miles, a thought could snuff out an enemy half a world away. A good reason not to gossip anymore…[/i]

Doubles Oblivion weapon range on headquarters.
